# criblio_system_limits (Resource)

SystemLimits Resource

Manages selected system limits for the Worker Group or Edge Fleet identified by `group_id` using `/m/{group_id}/system/limits`. Configure one resource per group.

Configure only the limits you want Terraform to manage. Before each create or update, the provider reads the current limits, merges configured attributes, and sends a complete configuration as required by the upstream PATCH endpoint. Unconfigured limits, including fields unknown to this provider version, are retained. Writable lists replace the existing list; configure an empty list to clear one. Removing an attribute from configuration stops managing it and retains its current server value.

The provider exposes `lookup_allowed_paths`, `lookup_max_size`, `lookup_max_total_size`, `enable_worker_in_memory`, and `metrics_directory` as read-only attributes and preserves their server values during updates. The four lookup and worker fields require Cribl Operator permissions in Cribl-managed deployments. Updating `metrics_directory` requires the backend `settings-limits-metrics-directory` feature flag.

Refresh reports remote changes to managed attributes. Import uses the group ID and reads all supported limits; retain only the attributes you intend to manage in your configuration. Destroy removes the resource from Terraform state and leaves the server configuration in place because the API has no delete operation. Avoid simultaneous writers: the API does not provide a conditional update for the read and PATCH sequence.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The provider reads existing limits and preserves unconfigured settings.
resource "criblio_system_limits" "default" {
  group_id       = "default"
  min_free_space = "2 GB"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Worker group ID.

### Optional

- `azure_blob_state_flush_interval` (Integer) How often the Azure Blob state service flushes state to the central KVStore (ms).
- `bundle_download_timeout_seconds` (Integer) The maximum time a Worker will wait for a successful Leader connection before canceling a download of a new configuration bundle. Default timeout is 10 minutes.
- `cpu_profile_ttl` (String) The time to live for collected CPU profiles.
- `default_heartbeat_seconds` (Integer) How many seconds a managed node will wait to send back a heartbeat to the Cribl control plane.
- `disable_metrics_accessor_cache` (Boolean) Consult Cribl Support before adjusting this advanced setting. Disable the metrics accessor cache.
- `edge_metrics_custom_expression` (String) JavaScript expression to filter metrics.
- `edge_metrics_mode` (String) Choose a set of metrics for Edge Nodes to send to the Leader, or define a custom set.
- `edge_nodes_count` (Integer) Used to pre-allocate connection handlers. Changing this value could restart currently running connection handlers, causing all Edge Nodes to reconnect.
- `enable_metrics_persistence` (Boolean) Disable to stop writing metrics to disk.
- `enable_process_info_using_windows_tools` (Boolean) Enable PowerShell to collect process information instead of using the native API.
- `events_metadata_sources` (List of String) List of event metadata sources to enable.
- `hb_connection_mode` (String) Persistent: connection stays open. Ephemeral: connection can disconnect after a configured duration. Auto: treated as persistent in this version.
- `hb_metric_spool_max_file_size` (String) Maximum file size per slice in the heartbeat metric spool. Active only in ephemeral mode.
- `hb_metric_spool_max_size` (String) Maximum disk size for the heartbeat metric spool persistent queue. In ephemeral mode, 0 disables disk persistence and buffers metrics in RAM only.
- `hb_offline_duration` (String) Time before marking node offline. Format: number plus unit (s, m, h, or d), e.g. 60s, 5m, 1h. Unitless values are treated as seconds. Minimum 2m.
- `kv_store_enable_wal` (Boolean) Enable the write-ahead log for the KVStore.
- `kv_store_service_period` (Integer) How often the KVStore syncs itself to disk. When WAL mode is enabled, deltas to the KVStore are synced to disk immediately as they happen; however, the WAL is merged back into the overall KVStore on this interval.
- `kv_store_wal_max_bytes` (Integer) The amount of bytes to allow a WAL file to get to before committing the WAL back into the KVStore.
- `large_events_threshold` (String) Deprecated. Large events are now tracked using a histogram with fixed buckets.
- `max_dimension_value_size` (Integer) Maximum allowed length, in characters, for a metric dimension value. Metric series with a dimension value exceeding this limit are dropped.
- `max_eps` (Integer) Maximum number of event processors (EPs) that all sources can create collectively within a worker process. When this limit is reached, new connections or requests are rejected to limit worker resources. Set to 0 to disable the limit.
- `max_event_bytes_mode` (String) Consult Cribl Support before adjusting this advanced setting. How the event breaker handles a segment that exceeds maxEventBytes with no break boundary: 'drop' emits the bounded head and discards the remainder through the next boundary; 'split' preserves every byte as bounded fragments.
- `max_metrics` (Integer) The system's total allowed number of metric series. Consult Cribl Support before updating this value.
- `max_pipelines_per_pack` (Integer) Maximum number of pipelines allowed in a single Pack. Packs above this limit are rejected at install time, because loading very large Packs can exhaust a worker group's config helper memory. Consult Cribl Support before updating this value.
- `max_pq_size` (String) Highest accepted value for individual integrations' persistent queue 'Max queue size' parameters. Consult Cribl Support before increasing the default 1 TB.
- `max_reconnect_interval` (String) The maximum time to wait before attempting to reconnect to the Leader after being disconnected.
- `metrics_drop_list` (List of String) List of metric names to drop. Supports wildcards.
- `metrics_fields_blacklist` (List of String) List of event fields for which to disable metric collection.
- `metrics_gc_period` (String) The interval at which the system attempts to free memory by pruning stale metrics from the Stream system metrics store.
- `metrics_max_cardinality` (Integer) The system's allowed number of permutations of a given metric name.
- `metrics_max_disk_space` (String) Maximum allowed disk space for persisting metrics to disk.
- `metrics_never_drop_list` (List of String) List metric names for which to ensure delivery. Supports wildcards.
- `metrics_worker_id_blacklist` (List of String) List of metric names for which to disable tracking of Worker Node ID. Supports wildcards.
- `min_free_space` (String) The minimum amount of disk space in the system before various features will take measures to prevent disk usage (KB, MB, etc.).
- `min_reconnect_interval` (String) The minimum time to wait before attempting to reconnect to the Leader after being disconnected. The interval is doubled with each failed reconnect attempt until the maximum limit is reached.
- `net_flow_template_flush_interval` (Integer) Consult Cribl Support before adjusting this advanced setting. It determines how often the NetFlow template service sends templates to the central KVStore.
- `random_reconnect_interval` (String) Maximum random delay added to every connection or reconnect attempt — including the initial connection, error-backoff retries, and ephemeral-mode offline cycles. Set to a non-zero value to stagger simultaneous connection attempts across a large Fleet and avoid spiking the leader with too many attempts (aka thundering herd problem).
- `rate_limit_bytes_per_second` (String) Consult Cribl Support before adjusting this advanced setting. The maximum number of bytes per second that a worker is allowed to ingest. If 0 or not configured, no rate limiting is applied. A value of 'auto' means the limit is determined automatically based on configurations.
- `samples` (Attributes) Samples configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--samples))
- `worker_max_metrics` (Integer) The maximum number of metric series allowed per worker. Consult Cribl Support before updating this value.

### Read-Only

- `enable_worker_in_memory` (Boolean) Whether worker connection data is retained only in memory. Cloud changes require Cribl Operator permissions; exposed read-only by this provider.
- `lookup_allowed_paths` (List of String) Additional permitted lookup directories. Cloud changes require Cribl Operator permissions; exposed read-only by this provider.
- `lookup_max_size` (String) Maximum disk space for a single lookup file. Cloud changes require Cribl Operator permissions; exposed read-only by this provider.
- `lookup_max_total_size` (String) Maximum disk space for lookup data and metadata. Cloud changes require Cribl Operator permissions; exposed read-only by this provider.
- `managed_fields` (List of String) Provider-maintained list of configured limit field paths. Tracks ownership changes even when a managed value is absent from the API.
- `metrics_directory` (String) Directory for persisted metrics. Changes require the backend settings-limits-metrics-directory feature flag; exposed read-only by this provider.

### Nested Schema for `samples`

Required:

- `max_size` (String) Maximum file size for the sample, in binary units (KB, MB). (Max. 3MB.).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = criblio_system_limits.default
  id = "default"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import criblio_system_limits.default default
```
